text:
kai: quick heads-up — bringing up rwd-qlm-3b quantized (8-bit) on staging and seeing apparent regression on promptset_v2 during the eval sweep. suspect duplicate/sample leakage is skewing the metrics.

kai: repro notes: fp16 vs 8bit shows consistent drop on our anchor prompts (instr-follow + hallucination checks). full run logs attached to the job but the immediate suspect is dataset dupes between sample_bank and golden.

kai: quick dedupe query I ran:
```sql
-- fingerprints that appear more than once in the candidate pool / sample bank
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) as cnt
FROM prompts p
WHERE p.bucket = 'sample_bank'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

anna: can you drop the first 20 rows here? I can run a fast fingerprint-unique rewrite of that shard. do we want fingerprint-only dedupe or fuzzy dedupe (edit-dist / embedding-threshold)?

kai: pasting top 3 examples (normalized text hashes) — two are near-identical paraphrases, one is exact dup. leaning to do fingerprint dedupe first then a second pass embedding-based threshold at 0.92.

mike: +1 on two stage. Exact dedupe must run before any evals. If we leave paraphrases we still risk overcounting similar answers in golden. For quant bring-up we need a conservative eval set.

sarah: proposed action:
- freeze current golden set snapshot (gs-2026-03-15-q1)
- create candidate snapshot after exact dedupe (cand-205678)
- run embedding similarity filter against golden embeddings with threshold 0.92 (cosine) to remove near-duplicates
- only after above do we run the quantized vs fp16 evals for model selection
Please do NOT relabel golden items until I confirm snapshot.

jonah: tagging/labeling ops: we can prioritize relabels but need exact counts. if we run the embedding filter we should output a priority list (risk score: anchor-match + model-diff). we have ~400 relabel slots this week.

kai: sampling command I used (so you can reproduce):
```bash
redwood-sample --bank sample_bank --mode stratified --buckets instruction,qa,multi --size 5000 \\n  --seed 42 --emit-fingerprint --out cand-205678.ndjson
```

anna: i'll run an exact-fingerprint dedupe job against cand-205678 and produce cand-205678-exactdedup. ETA ~1.5h. will also generate a small manifest with counts per fingerprint.

labeling-bot: task CREATED TASK-3421: "relabel-priority-cand-205678" assigned to @jonah team. payload: cand-205678-exactdedup.manifest, priority=high, expected-rows=380

jonah: acknowledged. will triage TASK-3421 tomorrow AM and push top 200 into labeling queue. need final priority scoring from eng (kai/mike/sarah).

mike: i'll produce a simple priority script — score = anchor_weight*anchor_match + delta_weight*model_score_diff + novelty_penalty*sim_to_golden. will push as small notebook and generate list.

kai: note on eval gating: if the quantized model shows >1.5% drop on anchor-F1 relative to fp16 we auto-fail canary and fallback. ops-bot can you bake a fallback?

ops-bot: canary plan prepped. rollout window: 09:00–12:00 UTC tomorrow. fallback policy: revert to fp16 and route traffic to dedicated pool if anchor-F1 drop > 1.5% or latency regress > 20ms. I will attach metric hooks to the eval job.

sarah: i'll snapshot golden embeddings and label metadata now: snapshot id gs-2026-03-15-q1-snap2. DO NOT CHANGE golden membership until I post final confirmation.

anna: exact dedupe done — cand-205678-exactdedup has 4.3% fewer rows. uploading manifest now: s3://redwood-curation/cand-205678-exactdedup.manifest.json

kai: thanks. mike, can you run the priority script on that manifest and drop results in the thread?

mike: dropped priority list in the job: https://internal.redwood/jobs/99812/priority-list.csv — top 380 exported.

jonah: queued top 200 for labeling. will update TASK-3421 with ETA and assignees.

kai: summary / ask:
- anna: run embedding-filter pass and produce final candidate set
- sarah: keep golden frozen and snapshot (ack)
- mike: produce priority list (done)
- jonah/labeling: label top N (queued)
- ops-bot: canary ready (ack)
I'll block further eval runs until we finish the filter and relabel pass. ping if anything blocks. :pray:

anna: ack. starting embedding pass now; should be <2h.

sarah: thanks all. once relabels are in we'll re-run the full quant evaluation and decide. :thumbsup:
